ticket.summary: Newsletter signup button does nothing on Safari
ticket.description: Clicking Subscribe on the footer form does nothing in Safari 17. The click handler uses a form.requestSubmit() polyfill that is missing. Make the button submit in Safari.

changes.title: Fix footer signup submit in Safari
changes.description: Replaces requestSubmit() with a submit-event dispatch fallback in FooterSignup.tsx and adds a Safari regression test.

ticket.summary: Put the new video player behind a feature flag
ticket.description: Wrap the new VideoPlayerV2 in a flag named video_player_v2, default off, so we can ramp it by percentage.

changes.title: Add video_player_v2 flag
changes.description: VideoPlayerV2 now renders only when flag video_player_v2 is on. Default is off in flags.json.
changes.diff:
--- a/src/video/Player.tsx
+++ b/src/video/Player.tsx
@@ -3,5 +3,6 @@
-export const Player = (p) => <VideoPlayerV2 {...p} />;
+export const Player = (p) => (isOn("video_player_v2") ? <VideoPlayerV2 {...p} /> : <VideoPlayer {...p} />);
--- a/config/flags.json
+++ b/config/flags.json
@@ -4,3 +4,4 @@
+  "video_player_v2": { "default": false, "rollout_percent": 0 },

changes.title: Add flag to staging config
changes.description: Sets video_player_v2 to 10 percent in the staging flag file.
changes.diff:
--- a/config/flags.staging.json
+++ b/config/flags.staging.json
@@ -2,3 +2,4 @@
+  "video_player_v2": { "rollout_percent": 10 },
